lines.rom: om jaya citragupta hare svami jaya citragupta hare bhakta janom ke icchita phala ko purna kare
vighna vinasaka mamgalakarta santana sukhadayi bhaktana ke pratipalaka tribhuvana yasa chayi
rupa caturbhuja syamala murati pitambara rajai matu iravati daksina vama anga sajai
kasta nivarana dusta samharana prabhu antaryami srsti samharana jana duhkha harana prakata huye svami
kalama davata sankha patrika kara mem ati sohai vaijayanti vanamala tribhuvana mana mohai
simhasana ka karya sambhala brahma harsaye taimtisa koti devata caranana mem dhaye
nrpati saudasa bhisma pitamaha yada tumhem kinha vegi vilamba na layo icchita phala dinha
dara suta bhagini saba apane svastha ke karta jaum kaham sarana mem kisaki tuma taja maim bharta

jo jana citragupta ji ki arati prema sahita gavaim caurasi se niscita chutaim icchita phala pavaim
